description:
Perform a medication safety screen for a patient starting the cancer drug Vemurafenib who is currently taking three Parkinson's disease medications: Ropinirole, Co-careldopa, and Entacapone. 

Using the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app:
1. Select 'Vemurafenib' as the cancer drug.
2. Add all three co-medications: 'Ropinirole', 'Co-careldopa' (may appear as Levodopa/Carbidopa), and 'Entacapone'.
3. Check the interaction results.
4. Create a safety report file at '/sdcard/parkinsons_safety_report.txt' with the following format:

Cancer Drug: Vemurafenib
Ropinirole: [Color]
Co-careldopa: [Color]
Entacapone: [Color]
High Risk Drug: [Name of the drug with Red/Orange interaction]
